auditMetadata.title: Project Setup & Storage Production Verification Audit

section1_projectSetupUi.details: ProjectSetupWizard correctly exposes all 5 staged phases: 1. Foundation, 2. Carrier & Operational Roster, 3. Pricing Rules, 4. Governance & Access, 5. Review & Activate. The legacy giant wizard is not reachable in production.

section2_projectCode.details: projectCode is generated authoritatively by ProjectNumberGenerator in sequence Q-PRJ-001, Q-PRJ-002... Inputs cannot overwrite it. Existing projectCode values are immutable.

section3_googleWorkspaceFoundation.details: Projects can exist without Google provisioning (status: PENDING). Drive/Sheet IDs default safely to strings/null and never become undefined. Retry logic exists and reuses the existing projectCode without generating duplicate sequence IDs.

section4_storageProfileUi.details: Storage Profile Card displays human-readable details including provider, root folder path display, Master Sheet status, provisioning status, and last verification timestamp.

section5_storageMigrationLogic.details: Previous storage remains active during REQUESTED, VALIDATING, COPYING, VERIFYING. Active storage pointer in Firestore switches ONLY at READY_TO_SWITCH -> SWITCHED. Failed migration keeps previous storage active and old storage folders are preserved (archived).

section6_storageHistory.details: History is append-only. Previous storage locations are preserved as ARCHIVED. Migration metadata (jobId, copied files count, fileIdMap) is preserved.

section7_projectArchive.details: Project archive generator bundles all datasets and manifest into a .zip file. Security helper sanitizeObj strips OAuth tokens, client secrets, and private credentials.

section8_pilotToCompany.details: Supports both MY_DRIVE (pilot) and SHARED_DRIVE (production) seamlessly without requiring changes to core project or trip architecture.

section9_projectLifecycle.details: Strict lifecycle DRAFT -> SETUP -> READY_FOR_REVIEW -> APPROVED -> ACTIVE is enforced. Field operations and trip dispatch are blocked until project reaches ACTIVE status.

section10_regression.details: Google Sign-In, Auth refresh, Admin Console, User Approval, Dashboard, System Tools, Workspace, Trip FSM, and i18n key parity (1128/1128/1128) verified without regression.

section11_build.lint: FAIL (tsc --noEmit flagged strict property type mismatches in scripts/test_storage_migration.ts - left unmodified as per read-only directive)
section11_build.build: PASS (vite build & esbuild server.ts compiled dist/server.cjs successfully)
